title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: 1.10.0 adds Android Studio-style navigation history, a broader set of Kotlin/Android code insights, and browser build parity for web-hosted installs.

highlights.title: Navigation history
highlights.description: Back, Forward, and Clear History commands make it easier to retrace jumps across definitions, implementations, and usages.

highlights.title: Android insights
highlights.description: New folding, hover, gutter, and diagnostic features surface Kotlin and Android context directly in the editor.

highlights.title: Browser parity
highlights.description: A dedicated browser entrypoint and browser-safe stubs improve packaging consistency for web-hosted installs.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Added Android Studio-style navigation history with Back, Forward, and Clear History commands, so jumps between definitions, implementations, and usages are easier to retrace.
Added new Kotlin and Android code insights including const val folding, suspend call markers, version catalog hover, override/implement gutter indicators, and folding for R.color resources.
Added resource diagnostics for unresolved R.string and R.color references, making broken Android resource lookups visible directly in the editor.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Fixed Go to Class Implementation and related implementation navigation commands so they register reliably and open the target editor correctly during navigation flows and tests.
Fixed parser, definition, and hover edge cases around string interpolation, Android R.type.name references, inherited properties, and same-file symbol resolution.

sections.heading: Packaging and docs
bullets: Added a dedicated browser entrypoint plus browser-safe stubs, bringing the web build closer to parity with the desktop extension for supported features.
Updated manual install commands in the README to reference the 1.10.0 VSIX package.
